title: The Insane Story Behind Ferrari's First Plug-In Hybrid
description:
In twenty ten, Ferrari's chairman stood at the Geneva Motor Show next to a green Ferrari and promised that hybrid versions of all its models would arrive within three or four years. It did not happen. It took almost a decade, a hypercar, the death of the company's most powerful boss, and a new chief executive from a tobacco company before Ferrari finally built its first plug-in hybrid. That car was the SF90 Stradale. Almost one thousand horsepower, three electric motors, and a battery you plug into the wall. Today, about half of the cars Ferrari delivers are hybrids. But the road from that green concept to the SF90 was much stranger than most people know.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
